_comment: Copy this file to profile.json and fill in your own info. The LLM prompts read this at runtime — every blurb references the fields below. profile.json is gitignored by default, so your real values never leave your machine.
name: Your Full Name
_visa_examples: Examples: 'US citizen' | 'Green card holder' | 'F-1 (CPT eligible)' | 'F-1 (OPT until <date>)' | 'H-1B' | 'Will require sponsorship'
_stack_note: Your headline tech stack — surfaces in closing lines + opening hooks.
voice: tired-but-confident grad student writing to a small team where her output will be visible. Not a marketing brochure.
_voice_note: How the LLM should sound when writing your blurbs. Tweak to your style.
_default_radio_note: Bookmarklet auto-fills Yes/No radio buttons using these defaults when it can match the question text. Set 'us_citizen' to 'yes' if you ARE a US citizen and want Yes for those questions.
_forbidden_note: Topics the LLM must NEVER mention in a blurb to recruiters. Add anything related to this tool or other meta-tooling you'd find embarrassing to expose.
